title: Sources: Cerebras plans to raise its IPO price range from $115-$125 per share to $150-$160 per share, potentially raising ~$4.8B at the top of the new range (Echo Wang/Reuters)
summary: Echo Wang / Reuters: Sources: Cerebras plans to raise its IPO price range from $115-$125 per share to $150-$160 per share, potentially raising ~$4.8B at the top of the new range — Cerebras Systems is set to raise the size and price of its initial public offering as soon as Monday, as demand …
